species_support: mouse study systems only; human and rat not directly assayed
support_kind: family-level homophilic trans adhesion; no exact-pair assay
evidence_summary: The 2022 primary study used mouse clustered-protocadherin EC1-4 constructs and directly tested selected isoforms including beta6 and beta8, but not Pcdhb2. The 2017 cited source is a review of representative clustered-protocadherin structures and cell assays, not an exact Pcdhb2-Pcdhb2 primary assay. Family-level homophilic recognition therefore does not establish this submitted pair.
limitations: No cited source reports Pcdhb2-Pcdhb2 binding, cell aggregation, adhesion, receptor activation, or receptor-dependent function; no submitted-isoform receptor complex/chain assay was found. Expression, orthology, and family-wide specificity were not transferred to the exact pair.
audit_notes: Submitted promote_candidate is unsupported by the cited sources; the relevant receptor is a single Pcdhb2 isoform homodimer with an EC1-4 trans interface, but that exact chain was not tested.
